episodes.synopsis: While exploring the Abyss, Riko comes across something she has never seen before. How does this new discovery impact her?
episodes.title: The City of the Great Pit

episodes.synopsis: Riko and Reg find out more about their past but the question still remains, who or what exactly is Reg?
episodes.title: Resurrection Festival

episodes.synopsis: Reg goes on his first cave raid! Meanwhile, Riko makes preparations to go into the abyss to find her mother.
episodes.title: Departure

episodes.synopsis: Riko and Reg start their adventure into the Abyss, while there they run into an unexpected familiar face.
episodes.title: The Edge of the Abyss

episodes.synopsis: Riko and Reg descend into the Forest of Temptation. What new dangers will they find laying in wait for them there?
episodes.title: Incinerator

episodes.synopsis: Reg and Riko make it to the Seeker Camp where they meet Ozen the Immovable, the person who saved Riko all those years ago. But there is more to Ozen than meets the eye.
episodes.title: Seeker Camp

episodes.synopsis: Ozen reveals more about the Abyss as well as the truth behind Riko's origins. What will happen when Ozen shows her true colors?
episodes.title: The Unmovable Sovereign

episodes.synopsis: Ozen tasks Riko and Reg to survive alone outside the Seeker Camp. Do they come out alive and unscathed? Or does the Abyss have a dirty trick up its sleeve?
episodes.title: Survival Training

episodes.synopsis: Reg and Riko continue their descent after they leave Ozen's Seeker Camp. Riko's mettle is tested as Reg passes out and she has to fend for herself.
episodes.title: The Great Fault

episodes.synopsis: Reg and Riko run into trouble deep in the fourth layer where they meet an interesting creature, but are they friend or foe?
episodes.title: Poison and the Curse

episodes.synopsis: Nanachi sends Reg on a mission to find certain items that could possibly save Riko. Meanwhile, Nanachi reveals a little more about themself.
episodes.title: Nanachi

episodes.synopsis: Nanachi shows Reg the truth about the Abyss. Meanwhile, Riko is still recovering from her injuries when she has a strange dream.
episodes.title: The True Nature of the Curse

episodes.synopsis: Nanachi and Mitty's past is revealed. How did they become what they are and who is responsible for it? Meanwhile, Riko is on the mend after her injuries.
episodes.title: The Challengers
